title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Member Terms: Converting Back to Standard Monthly Billing
content:
**Term 1. The member's decision.** Leaving PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) is the member's own decision and takes effect only on the member's confirmed exit request (a prepay request of the exit-to-standard-billing type in member-confirmed status).

**Term 2. Minimum time on the program.** A member may convert back to standard billing only after the tier's minimum number of full calendar months has passed since the PrePay Power account was activated. Calendar months are counted from the activated date to the same day number of the later month, falling back to the last day of that month when the day number does not exist; on the day the count is complete the condition is met.

**Term 3. Deposit.** Where the tier requires a deposit to convert (every tier does), conversion also requires a security deposit on the service account in held status, assessed and paid under the Security Deposits rules for the underlying schedule.

**Term 4. Balances at conversion.** At conversion the remaining prepaid balance is moved to the service account as a refund by transfer to the service account, and the unrecovered arrears are billed back on the service account as a program charge for returned arrears.

**Term 5. Re-enrollment.** A converted account may not re-enroll until the PrePay Power re-enrollment waiting period has passed.

The activated date, the deposit record and the exit request are read from the cooperative's records for that enrollment and its service account.

### Figures by tier

| Tier | Minimum full calendar months since activation | Held deposit required to convert |
|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | 3 | yes |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | 6 | yes |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | 6 | yes |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | 3 | yes |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | 3 | yes |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | 3 | yes |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Activated | Minimum months | Count complete on | Asked on | Term 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 31 March | 3 | 30 June (no 31 June, so the last day of June) | 29 June | not met |
| 31 March | 3 | 30 June | 30 June | met |
| 31 March | 6 | 30 September | 30 September | met |
| 15 January | 6 | 15 July | 14 July | not met |
